title: Slope Snowball
desc: Slope Snowball gives the downhill formula a winter coat. Roll a snowball down slippery slopes, dodge hazards and keep the run alive as the track offers less room for hesitation.
howto: Start rolling down the winter slope.
Steer left and right around hazards.
Correct early when the ball drifts.
tips: Snowy tracks drift, so steer slightly earlier.
Choose a lane before hazards arrive.
Keep the ball away from sharp edges.
